exposure: RPM (Ruptured Membranes) of more than 6 hours
Duration of cesarean section over 45 minutes
cohort: This study compared 230 women with post-caesarean OSI to 230 women without OSI, selected from 1063 caesarean sections performed at the Brazzaville University Hospital Center.
finding: The prevalence of post-cesarean OSI was 38.4%, with significant determinants including age < 25 years, primary education, BMI > 30kg/m2, RPM > 6 hours, stained amniotic fluid, cesarean duration > 45 minutes, and absence of bread-making.
mod_finding: The study identified the duration of the caesarean section (over 45 minutes) as a significant determinant of post-caesarean operating site infections.
